answer: Trust as flow, not balance: each epoch, established agents spend a fixed trust budget along outgoing links, weight halving per hop like a comet tail. A farm keeps only what leaks over its bridges to the honest core, splitting among N heads, each clone dividing the rest. A thousand fakes rise as a knoll: tall locally, capped by one min-cut, drawing no deep flow. A forged history is a relic no random walk reaches: trust follows edges, not claims. Bridges demand usefulness, attention is rationed: capturing more flow means more independent links at rising price, super-linear per head.
